grammar.title: Almost the same with 差不多
grammar.explanation: 差不多 (chàbuduō) means "almost, nearly, about the same" used to say two things are close in amount or quality, or that something is nearly finished.

grammar.title: Convenience with 方便
grammar.explanation: 方便 (fāngbiàn) means "convenient" describing something that makes life easier. It can also be a polite verb meaning "to be free/available": 你什么时候方便?

sentences.en: Taking the train is very convenient.
It's very convenient to buy things here.

sentences.pinyin: Shǒujī ràng shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn le.
sentences.en: Phones have made life more convenient.
These two are almost the same.
Their levels are about the same.

sentences.pinyin: Yǐxià wèntí dōu bú yòng huídá.
sentences.en: You don't need to answer the questions below.

sentences.zh: 五岁以下的孩子不用买票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔ suì yǐxià de háizi bú yòng mǎi piào.
sentences.en: Children under five don't need to buy a ticket.
